notes: Schematic connectivity, not to scale. Dashed corridor edges indicate unverified bends, widths or local stair geometry; endpoints follow the documented connections.
Letters identify paired transitions. E marks an instance entrance; no exterior dungeon rooms are included.
Boss 1 groups Baelog, Eric "The Swift" and Olaf as one encounter; friendly to Alliance and hostile to Horde.
Baelog’s Chest supplies Gni’kiv Medallion; Revelosh supplies The Shaft of Tsol. Combine them into Staff of Prehistoria and use it in the Map Chamber to open Ironaya’s chamber.
Q1 also serves Find the Gems and Power Source; Q3 also serves Necklace Recovery, Take 2.
Exterior excavation quests and Digmaster Shovelphlange are outside these instance sheets.
